name: heading
label: Heading
hint: Defaults to "ITAM Program Roadmap" when empty

name: eyebrow
label: Eyebrow label
hint: Small label above the heading. Defaults to "IT Asset Management" when empty

name: intro
label: Intro text
hint: Defaults to the program launch summary when empty

name: style
label: Style
hint: Light sits on the page background; Brand uses a dark brand-colored banner

name: show_search
label: Show search
hint: Search filters the ITAM Roadmap Board and ITAM Roadmap Timeline widgets on the same page

name: show_breadcrumb
label: Show breadcrumb
hint: Shows a Home / page title breadcrumb above the heading

name: primary_label
label: Primary button label
hint: Optional button under the intro. Shown only when the label and page are both set

name: primary_page
label: Primary button page ID
hint: Portal page the primary button opens, such as itam_roadmap

name: secondary_label
label: Secondary button label
hint: Optional outlined button next to the primary button

name: secondary_page
label: Secondary button page ID
hint: Portal page the secondary button opens

name: home_page
label: Home page ID
hint: Portal page the breadcrumb Home link opens. Defaults to "index" when empty
